The "Wanted" Letter from Ahmedabad: Daya's mother sends a letter labeled "Wanted Damadji," inviting the Gada family to Ahmedabad for Makar Sankranti (Uttarayan). While Bapuji, Daya, and Tapu are thrilled, Jethalal tries to avoid going to keep tabs on his shop.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
